# Extension download

`vibe-groceries-extension.zip` is the Firefox extension (the `extension/` folder minus dev tools), rebuilt
whenever the extension changes.

- **Quick install (temporary):** Firefox → `about:debugging` → This Firefox → Load Temporary Add-on → choose the
  zip. It's removed when Firefox restarts.
- **Permanent install:** sign it as an unlisted add-on at addons.mozilla.org (see the main README).

Direct link: https://github.com/ryarmst/vibe-groceries/raw/main/dist/vibe-groceries-extension.zip
